author: Marlon Chaviano
name: mobile-ignite
title: Mobile app with Ignite
description: Ignite by Infinite Red: the most battle-tested React Native boilerplate, with Expo, navigation, theming, i18n, MMKV and a structure that scales.

base.command: npx -y ignite-cli@latest new {{name}} --yes --workflow=cng --remove-demo --install-deps=false --git=false --packager=npm && cd {{name}} && perl -pi -e 's/getActiveRouteName\(navigationRef\.getRootState\(\)\)/getActiveRouteName(navigationRef.getRootState()!)/' app/navigators/navigationUtilities.ts

instructions:
## How to work here

- Follow Ignite's structure: screens in `app/screens/`, components in `app/components/`, theme in `app/theme/` and copy in `app/i18n/` (no loose text in components).
- Generate pieces with `npx ignite-cli generate screen <Name>` / `component <Name>` to keep the conventions.
- Before finishing: `npx tsc --noEmit`.
